goal: Deliver an offline-testable MVP backbone for unified Feishu admin, HR, and finance workflows while routing every Feishu API call through dc_engines.feishu_hub.

included: admin asset inventory, movements, low-stock alerts
finance approval records, attachment completeness checks, exception lists
HR onboarding tasks and interview/onboarding coordination records
business notification logs and Feishu integration health snapshots
approval instance sync adapter by approval_code and time window
excluded: security audit and offboarding drive backup

runtime_wiring.sensitive_config_rule: Business config may store app_token, table_id, approval_code, open_id, and chat_id, but must not store app_secret.

acceptance_criteria.description: The business MVP store creates all five required tables and supports asset stock deduction, return replenishment, low-stock detection, finance attachment exception lists, onboarding tasks, notification logs, and summary snapshots.
Bitable, approval, and notification adapters degrade cleanly when Feishu credentials are disabled and all enabled Feishu API calls are routed through feishu_hub.call with explicit method names.
Admin, finance, HR, and report plugins register the expected Web API endpoints without requiring live Feishu credentials and expose disabled/health states instead of throwing.
The contract stays valid and documents scope, wiring, table names, dashboard entries, and verification commands.
